verdict.rationale: The only directly relevant evidence is the Prompt Library, which tracks prompt versions with full diffs and lets requests reference a prompt by prompt_id, giving some versioning and review for one building block of automations. Nothing shows versioning or review of routing, fallback, or other automation configurations, and no rollback is documented. Missing for 10: versioning of policies and automation configs beyond prompts, a documented rollback or revert-to-previous-version capability, a review or approval workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
